brief:
A supermajority of Jewish Americans believe Israel's actions and the pro-Israel lobby group AIPAC contribute to antisemitism in the United States, according to Middle East Eye. The finding reflects deepening divisions within the American Jewish community over Israeli policy and its domestic consequences.

The survey also showed that a vast majority of Jewish voters support imposing sanctions against what they characterize as violent West Bank settlers, indicating broader concern among this demographic about Israeli settlement expansion and related violence.

title: Majority of Jewish Americans blame Israel and AIPAC for antisemitism
